The institutional investor held 32,244 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.41 million, up from 14,505 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Next Century Growth Investors Llc who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $920.53 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
